name: VictoriaMetrics
overview: The ultra-efficient TSDB default. Provides seamless compatibility with the Prometheus ecosystem while consuming a fraction of the RAM and storage.
details: VictoriaMetrics is a fast, cost-effective, and highly scalable time-series database. It serves as a direct, drop-in replacement for Prometheus, meaning it fully supports the PromQL querying language and natively accepts metrics from standard Prometheus Exporters.

Its primary advantage is architectural efficiency. It compresses time-series arrays aggressively, resulting in significantly lower disk I/O and RAM overhead compared to competitors. For the MetaClaw ecosystem, deploying the single-node version of VictoriaMetrics on the Archive plane allows the cluster to absorb millions of high-frequency hardware readings (from smart plugs, GPUs, and CPUs) without starving the primary LLM inference engines of resources.
